result.topic_en: The opening of a personal letter dated Göttingen, 8 February 1853, apologising for a missed birthday letter, with Riemann's unrelated calculations written over it: an integral with sin(pt), finite sums, and recurrence relations for a sequence λ_n, many of them written upside down.
result.transcription:
Göttingen, den 8. Febr. 1853

Lieber Wilhelm!

Durch deinen lieben Brief, den ich so eben erhielt, hast du feurige Kohlen auf mein Haupt gesammelt. Es war sehr Unrecht von mir, dir nicht zu deinem Geburtstage zu schreiben; aber ich bin vielleicht nicht so schuldig, als du glaubst, und ich {+will+} es nun dadurch wieder gut zu machen suchen, dass ich dir, so rasch wie möglich antworte.

$\mu^2 \int ( [-\ldots-] (x+t) + \xi x - t - 2\xi x ) \frac{\sin \mu t}{[-\ldots-]} [-\ldots-] (\frac{1}{t} + l t)\, \partial t$

$\int_0^\infty \xi\, t^2 \sin \mu t\, (\frac{1}{t} + l t)\, \partial t$

$\sum_{1,\infty} \frac{(nx)}{n^2}$ $\quad \sum (nx)$ $\quad \sum_{1,n-1} (\frac{m}{n}) = 0$ $\quad [\ldots]$

$\frac{m}{n} \sum_{1,n-1} m \quad \frac{n-1}{2} n$

$\frac{n-1}{2}$

[upside down:]
$\lambda_n + \lambda_{n-1} = 2n^2$
$\lambda_n = [-\ldots-] n^2 + [-\ldots-] n + \beta$
$\lambda_n = 2n^2$ [?]
$\lambda_n = n(n+1)$
$\sum c_n (\lambda_{n+1} - 2\lambda_n + \lambda_{n-1}) \ldots = 2 c_n \ldots$ [?]
$\sum_{n,\infty} \ldots = \lambda_n \ldots + \sum_{n+1,\infty} (\lambda_n + \lambda_{n-1}) \frac{\ldots}{n^2}$ [?]
$\Omega_n - \Omega_{n-1} = \sum (\ldots)$ [?]
$\Omega = \sum_{1,n} \ldots + \sum_{n,\infty} \ldots$ [?]
$\frac{1}{2}\lambda_{n+1} + \frac{2}{3}\lambda_n + \frac{1}{6}\lambda_{n-1} = 2n^2$ [?]
$\lambda_n = n^2 - \frac{1}{3}$ [?]
[further upside-down calculations largely illegible]

methods.what: Integral of a function against sin(μt) with weight (1/t + l t) over t from 0 to infinity
Arithmetic sum: sum of m from 1 to n-1 equals n(n-1)/2
Solving a linear recurrence for λ_n by a quadratic polynomial ansatz
Weighted recurrence with candidate solution λ_n = n^2 - 1/3

items.english: I will now try to make up for it by answering you as quickly as possible.
